basic_info.description: This stunning Russian Hill co-op offers breathtaking panoramic views that capture the North Bay, Alcatraz, and Fort Mason through floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors and a walk-out terrace. Located on the 9th floor, this one-bedroom, one-bathroom unit features a bedroom with oversized windows and striking southern views of Going up Russian Hill. The property's excellent location allows residents to easily walk to popular destinations like Ghirardelli Square, Aquatic Park, and the vibrant dining and shopping scenes along Chestnut, Polk, Union Streets, and North Beach. Residents enjoy exceptional amenities including one car parking, extra storage, laundry facilities on each floor, doorman and security services, guest parking, a club room, and a swimming pool.
